outcome: Ovarian stimulation outcomes (oocytes retrieved, metaphase II stage oocytes, fertilization rate, cleavage rate, high-quality embryo rate)
Neonatal outcomes (preterm birth, gestational age at delivery, Caesarean section, birthweight, small for gestational age, large for gestational age, birth defects)
cohort: 1011 infertile women undergoing their first IVF/ICSI treatment at the International Peace Maternity and Child Health Hospital between June 2015 and March 2018.
finding: Higher homocysteine (Hcy) levels were associated with lower clinical pregnancy and implantation rates, particularly in women with the MTHFR C677T TT genotype, but not with other IVF/ICSI or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Neonatal outcomes included Caesarean section rate, but no specific findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
